say:15:1610724011:1.text: Envoy, we've completed the preliminary examination of Headmaster Leymar's body.
say:15:1610724011:1.source_cn: 伊芙特使，我们已经对雷蒙校长的尸体做了初步检验。

say:16:1610724012:1.text: Our findings show he died several days before the selection exam. Trace analysis points to his office as the likely place of death.
say:16:1610724012:1.source_cn: 根据检验结果，我们确认雷蒙校长在选拔赛前数日就已死亡，...

say:17:1610724013:1.text: The fatal wound was at the back of the neck. Someone crushed it from behind with tremendous force, far beyond what any normal human could manage.
say:17:1610724013:1.source_cn: 他的致命伤位于后颈，简单来说，他是被凶手从身后以极大的...

say:18:1610724014:1.text: We tested for magical residue. The injury was purely physical, with no traces of magic.
say:18:1610724014:1.source_cn: 我们做了魔法反应测试，最终确认雷蒙校长的致命伤是纯粹的...

say:19:1610724015:1.text: These are the initial results. We're still running a full examination and will report back once it's complete.
say:19:1610724015:1.source_cn: 伊芙特使，这是初步的检查结论，我们还在对尸体进行进一步...

say:23:1610724016:1.text: You heard them. The physicians are still at work.
say:23:1610724016:1.source_cn: 你应该也听到了，医官还在对校长尸体进行进一步检查。
